UTN / Revel8 · Industry collaboration

MIME-aware phishing analysis

A parser-first pipeline for turning complex email content into structured model inputs and fine-grained phishing classifications.

The problem

MIME-formatted emails contain structure and content that must be processed before useful classification. The project addressed both preprocessing and the evaluation of fine-grained social-engineering categories.

What I built

In the UTN/Revel8 industry collaboration, I built a Python preprocessing and classification pipeline, extracted and normalized relevant email content, supported local and cloud-based inference, and fine-tuned RoBERTa and EmoBERTa classifiers.

Technical approach

The parser-first design separates email processing from model inference. Evaluation considered intent, tactics, tools, and psychological triggers, with model failure analysis used to examine where the system struggled.

Result & evidence

The resulting system combines structured preprocessing, multiple inference options, and fine-grained classification. The work included analyzing model failure cases, connecting data preparation with the quality of downstream predictions.

What this demonstrates

Data preprocessing, NLP model adaptation, inference integration, and systematic failure analysis in an industry-collaboration setting.
